Before we

01What does website development in Mathura include?+

The scope can include website strategy and information architecture, responsive design and development, local search and conversion foundations. We confirm the first useful release after reviewing the users, workflow and current tools.

02Will the website work well on mobile?+

Yes. Responsive layouts, readable content, touch-friendly controls and performance on common mobile devices are part of design and testing.

03Does WeTakeFWD have to be physically based in Mathura?+

No. We can deliver remotely for organisations in Mathura. Any on-site work, service area or local presence is described accurately and agreed before the project begins.
